title: Okanagan Falls Private Wine Tour - Full Day
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Regular pickup zone is all hotels, AirBnBs, and RV Parks and Campgrounds in Penticton and Okanagan Falls (Vernon, Kelowna, West Kelowna, Summerland, and Oliver & Osoyoos customers please call the office at the number listed on your voucher)
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Okanagan Falls wineries offer spectacular scenery, unrivalled winery experiences and exquisitely handcrafted wines.

Okanagan Falls landscapes are of legendary beauty. It is the valley’s most photographed vineyard views. And Okanagan Falls has been producing some of BC’s most celebrated wines for many years.

Warm days and cool nights produce wines with ripe fruit character and acidity. From vibrant sparkling wines and crisp Rieslings to complex Pinots and rich Syrah, there is truly something for everyone along this little stretch of paradise.
